title: Implement STARTTLS and AUTHINFO PLAIN
description:
Implement STARTTLS: respond 382, upgrade TCP connection to TLS using configured cert/key. Implement AUTHINFO USER/PASS: validate credentials from config file, set authenticated flag on session. Implement AUTHINFO SASL PLAIN. Artifact: reader/src/session/commands/auth.rs.

Acceptance:
- STARTTLS works with a self-signed cert in testing
- AUTHINFO USER/PASS returns 281 on success, 481 on failure
- Commands requiring authentication return 480 if not authenticated
- TLS version negotiated is TLS 1.2 minimum
